title: Nutshell Review (2026)
intro: Small-business CRM with pipelines, marketing add-ons, and AI assistance on a clear per-user ladder. This review covers verified 2026 pricing, core CRM capabilities, limitations, and who should buy — based on official first-party sources.
summary: Nutshell scores reflect first-party research — not hands-on product testing.
verdict: Nutshell is a solid SMB CRM with transparent USD pricing from Foundation through Enterprise and a 14-day trial. Best when you want approachable pipelines without suite complexity. Based on first-party research — not hands-on testing.

criterionAssessments.rationale: SMB-focused CRM with a clear plan ladder and approachable sales workflows.
Pipelines and deals are core; adequate for small-business sales motions.
Automation covers common SMB needs; Pro/Business deepen capability.
Email sync and marketing add-on path support SMB outreach.
Reporting fits SMB; advanced analytics buyers may prefer HubSpot/Salesforce.
Configurable enough for SMBs; not a no-code enterprise platform.
Common SMB integrations; ecosystem smaller than HubSpot.
Straightforward per-user ladder keeps admin lighter than suite platforms.
Business/Enterprise tiers exist; sweet spot remains small business.
Foundation from $13 annual and clear Growth/Pro ladder is strong SMB value.

bestFor: Buyers wanting transparent per-user CRM pricing
cons: Less ideal for complex enterprise sales
pricingSummary: No free plan. USD per user/mo annual/monthly: Foundation $13/$19, Growth $25/$32, Pro $42/$49, Business $59/$67, Enterprise $79/$89. 14-day trial.
limitations: Confirm live Nutshell checkout; packaging can change.
whoShouldChoose: Choose Nutshell when it matches your CRM buying criteria above.
whoShouldConsiderAlternatives: Consider alternatives like pipedrive, hubspot, keap if fit is weak.
